paragraph_move_structure: S1 [总图锚定与设计哲学 Visual Anchor & Philosophy]：Figure 2 illustrates the overall architecture of [Model], which processes [Input] through three sequential stages: [Stage 1], [Stage 2], and [Stage 3].
S2 [阶段 1 数据流 Stage 1 Flow]：Given raw input $\mathbf{X}$, the [Module 1] first transforms [Raw Input] into [Intermediate Representation $\mathbf{Z}^{(1)}$] to [Functional Purpose 1].
S3 [阶段 2 数据流 Stage 2 Flow]：Next, these [Summary Noun: representations $\mathbf{Z}^{(1)}$] are fed into [Module 2], which [Mechanism 2] to produce [Refined State $\mathbf{Z}^{(2)}$].
S4 [阶段 3 解码与闭环输出 Stage 3 Decoding]：Finally, the [Module 3] integrates $\mathbf{Z}^{(2)}$ with [Prior/Scale Cue] to output the final [Prediction/Action Trajectory].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: 严格的链式数据流（$\mathbf{X} \to \mathbf{Z}^{(1)} \to \mathbf{Z}^{(2)} \to \hat{\mathbf{Y}}$），每一句句首承接上一句的输出张量。绑定逻辑规则：L001, L003, L004.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Figure 2 shows our model. There is a Patch Encoder on the left. In the middle, there is a Spectral Block and a Graph Block. On the right, a Linear Decoder outputs the result.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 写成看图说话的静态空间方位描述（on the left, in the middle, on the right），没有体现张量变换的数据流动与功能因果。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Figure 2 illustrates the overall architecture of DyTS-Net, which maps raw sensor streams to multi-horizon forecasts through three sequential stages. Given an input sequence $\mathbf{X}$, the Adaptive De-stationary Tokenizer first separates local trend-scale statistics from normalized sub-series patches $\mathbf{Z}_0$. These normalized patches then pass through stacked Spectral-Spatial Mixing blocks, which jointly filter high-frequency channel noise in the Fourier domain and propagate cross-sensor phase dependencies via a sparse directed graph. Finally, the Scale-Guided Decoder fuses the refined structural representations with the projected neural-ODE scale trajectory to reconstruct the multi-horizon output $\hat{\mathbf{Y}}$.

focal_blueprints.title_zh: 全文总结与学术影响收尾段（Conclusion & Broader Outlook）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写整篇小论文的 Conclusion：不简单复制粘贴 Abstract，而是从更高维度总结本文解决的科学矛盾、方法精髓、实证高度与领域启示。
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [核心科学问题闭合 Scientific Closure]：In this paper, we addressed the fundamental tension between [Goal A] and [Goal B] in [Domain].
S2 [方法论精髓回顾 Methodological Synthesis]：By introducing [Model/Mechanism], we demonstrated that [Core Insight] enables [Capability] without incurring [Traditional Penalty].
S3 [实证结果高度概括 Empirical Recap]：Comprehensive evaluations across [Benchmarks/Hardware] confirmed consistent error reductions of up to [X%] alongside substantial inference speedups.
S4 [跨领域迁移展望 Broader Outlook]：Beyond [Current Task], our [Core Principle] offers a generalizable blueprint for broader sequential decision-making tasks under non-stationary environments.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Tension Resolved -> Methodological Insight -> Empirical Confirmation -> Generalizable Blueprint. 绑定逻辑规则：L013, L023, L029.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: In conclusion, we proposed DyTS-Net in this paper. It has a spectral module and an ODE module. Experiments show that it achieves state-of-the-art performance on many datasets. We hope our work will inspire more researchers in the future.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 机械重复摘要且句式干瘪，末句 We hope our work will inspire... 属于典型的中式客套收尾。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: In this work, we resolved the long-standing tension between shift-invariant normalization and physical amplitude preservation in non-stationary time series forecasting. By decoupling frequency-domain phase attention from continuous neural-ODE scale tracking, DyTS-Net captures long-range seasonal dependencies while accurately reconstructing extreme peak magnitudes. Empirical evaluations across eight benchmarks and industrial wind-power telemetry demonstrated MSE reductions of up to 17.4% alongside a 45% reduction in computational overhead. Beyond forecasting, this structural-scale disentanglement principle provides a generalizable foundation for anomaly detection and closed-loop predictive control in non-stationary cyber-physical systems.

focal_blueprints.title_zh: 问题诊断与靶向解决方案段：拒绝“政府应该立法”万金油（Targeted Problem-Solution）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写 Problem-Solution 类作文的解决方案段：针对前文诊断出的两个具体根源，提出两项可操作、有明确执行主体和传导机制的靶向对策，拒绝只喊 'The government should make laws and raise awareness'。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / 政策与工程治理方案段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [对策总起句 Targeted Solution Thesis]：Mitigating [Problem X] effectively requires coordinated intervention across both [Level A: Technical/Curriculum Design] and [Level B: Institutional Governance].

S2 [对策 1：操作层可验证改革 Actionable Measure 1]：First, [Specific Actor 1, e.g., university departments] should replace [Vulnerable Practice] with [Verifiable Mechanism, e.g., oral defense and in-class iterative drafting], ensuring that [Specific Effect 1].

S3 [对策 2：制度/标准层激励对齐 Actionable Measure 2]：Concurrently, [Specific Actor 2, e.g., regulatory agencies / industry consortia] must establish [Concrete Standard, e.g., mandatory provenance watermarking and audit logs] to penalize [Misconduct].
S4 [协同闭环效果 Combined Outcome]：Together, aligning pedagogical verification with technical traceability curbs misuse without stifling legitimate innovation.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Dual-Level Intervention -> Actor 1 + Concrete Mechanism -> Actor 2 + Concrete Standard -> Balanced Closure. 绑定逻辑规则：L002, L010.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: To solve this problem, first, the government should pass strict laws to punish bad people. Second, schools and media should educate the public and raise their awareness. Only in this way can we build a harmonious society.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 典型的中式六级万金油套话（pass strict laws, raise awareness, Only in this way can we...），放之四海而皆空，考官已产生严重审美疲劳。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Curbing the proliferation of fabricated academic data requires coordinated reforms across both peer-review protocols and institutional promotion criteria. First, journal editorial boards should mandate that empirical submissions include executable code containers and raw sensor logs, enabling automated reproducibility checks before external review. Concurrently, university tenure committees must shift evaluation weight from raw publication counts toward verified open-source contributions and replication studies. Aligning technical verification with career incentives removes the underlying pressure to fabricate incremental results.

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 成段后七维自检清单（The 7-Point Paragraph Audit Checklist）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 写完或改完任何一个英语段落，必须依次用七把尺子过筛：① 首句是否一眼看清本段唯一核心主张？② 每句主语是否控制在 6–8 词以内（无头重脚轻）？③ 句与句之间是否遵循“旧信息在前、新信息在后”？④ 所有的 This/Such 后是否都跟了精准汇总名词？⑤ 是否彻底清除了口语词与 AI 套话？⑥ 所有的程度主张是否都有具体指标、基线或微观案例支撑？⑦ 主动与被动语态的切换是否服务于信息焦点？
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Audit(Para) = Unity(1) + ShortSubject(2) + GivenToNew(3) + SummaryNoun(4) + ZeroAI_ZeroColloquial(5) + ConcreteMetricOrCase(6) + PurposefulVoice(7).
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 写完只检查拼写和单复数，不检查段落骨架、信息流与论证闭环。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Checking only spelling and grammar while leaving a 22-word subject, bare 'This', and unsubstantiated 'very good performance' untouched.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Applying the 7-point audit systematically: compressing the 22-word subject to 4 words, replacing bare 'This' with 'This phase lag', and replacing 'very good' with 'a 14.6% MSE reduction on Weather'.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 将抽象的“改作文/改论文”转化为 7 个可逐项打勾的工程化核验动作。

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 先让步、再釜底抽薪式反驳（Concession-Pivot-Refutation）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 无论是论文引言批评前人方法、Rebuttal 回复审稿人，还是六级/雅思大作文回应反方观点，最高级的说服力都来自“先承认对方在特定受限条件下确实有效（Concession），再指出该条件在真实/复杂场景下不成立（Pivot & Refutation）”。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Admittedly / While [Prior Method / Opposing View] achieves [Specific Merit] under [Strict Assumption A], this assumption breaks down when [Real-World Condition B], resulting in [Concrete Failure].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 一上来全盘否定前人工作（Previous works are totally wrong/useless），显得极不客观且容易激怒审稿人。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: MLP-based forecasters are too simple and cannot model complex dependencies, so our Transformer model is necessary.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: While lightweight MLP forecasters achieve competitive accuracy on stationary sequences with stable periodicity, their fixed temporal weights cannot adapt dynamically when industrial sensor streams undergo abrupt regime shifts.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 先肯定 MLP 在平稳周期序列上的竞争力，再精准指出其“固定时间权重无法适应突发工况漂移”的结构性软肋，有理有据。

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L030 成段后七维自检清单（The 7-Point Paragraph Audit Checklist））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 写成看图说话的静态空间方位描述（on the left, in the middle, on the right），没有体现张量变换的数据流动与功能因果。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Figure 2 illustrates the overall architecture of DyTS-Net, which maps raw sensor streams to multi-horizon forecasts through three sequential stages. Given an input sequence $\mathbf{X}$, the Adaptive De-stationary Tokenizer first separates local trend-scale statistics from normalized sub-series patches $\mathbf{Z}_0$. These normalized patches then pass through stacked Spectral-Spatial Mixing blocks, which jointly filter high-frequency channel noise in the Fourier domain and propagate cross-sensor phase dependencies via a sparse directed graph. Finally, the Scale-Guided Decoder fuses the refined structural representations with the projected neural-ODE scale trajectory to reconstruct the multi-horizon output $\hat{\mathbf{Y}}$.

Varying the phase regularization weight $\lambda$ across $[0.05, 0.50]$ alters validation MSE by less than 1.4%, indicating a wide, tuning-friendly operating plateau around $\lambda=0.15$. Under stress tests where 30% of sensor readings are randomly masked or corrupted by impulse noise ($\text{SNR} = 5\text{ dB}$), point-wise Transformer baselines suffer a 34.2% error surge, whereas DyTS-Net degrades by only 4.8%. This robustness stems from our spectral energy gate, which automatically attenuates high-entropy corrupted channels prior to cross-variate message passing.

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Weighing both dimensions demonstrates that the structural scientific gains of open-weight foundation models far outweigh their manageable misuse risks. While公开 releasing model weights lowers the barrier for generating deceptive phishing content, such downstream abuse can be substantially contained through cryptographic provenance standards and endpoint spam filters. By contrast, open weights provide academic laboratories and resource-constrained hospitals with transparent, auditable architectures that proprietary black-box APIs cannot substitute—accelerating reproducible breakthroughs in protein folding and rare-disease diagnostics. Because the security risks are mitigable via defense-in-depth whereas the scientific transparency is irreplaceable, open research ecosystems yield a decisive net benefit.
